data.name: Tracks @ XLab
data.description: A technical track on AI control and a governance track on verifying international AI agreements – with primary literature, interactive demos, and writing practice.

data.name: AI Risk Fundamentals
data.description: Based heavily on the book "If Anyone Builds It, Everyone Dies" – covering the core case for why superintelligent AI could be catastrophic, and what should be done about it.

data.name: DeepMind AGI Safety Short Course
data.description: 75-minute course covering alignment problems expected as AI capabilities advance. Includes recorded talks, exercises, and an accompanying workbook.

data.name: Agent Foundations for Superintelligence-Robust Alignment
data.description: Guide to the cluster of thought which expects solving alignment in a way which scales to superintelligence to require well-specified proposals guided by strong theoretical understanding.

data.name: AI Safety Atlas
data.description: Textbook systematically mapping the landscape of AI safety knowledge. Ideas are laid out in a carefully structured narrative where concepts build naturally on previous ones.
data.organizer: Centre pour la Sécurité de l'IA (CeSIA)

data.name: Iliad Intensive
data.description: In-depth introduction to foundational AI alignment for people with strong backgrounds in mathematics, physics, or theoretical computer science.

data.name: Intro to Transformative AI
data.description: Intensive 5-unit course helping people fast-track their understanding of AI’s impact on society and start taking their first steps in making a contribution to AI safety.

data.name: AI Futurism Reading List
data.description: Guide to readings which seem valuable for thinking about key future dynamics in advanced AI development – timelines, takeoff, misalignment, control, governance, and strategy.

data.name: CS 2881: AI Safety
data.description: Graduate-level course at Harvard University examining technical challenges in AI safety, including adversarial robustness, jailbreaks, interpretability, and potential catastrophic capabilities.

data.name: Deep Dive
data.description: Designed as a 201 AI policy course, helping you find your footing in the vast AI governance landscape by engaging with various dimensions.
data.organizer: European Network for AI Safety (ENAIS) and AI Safety Hungary

data.name: Language Models and Intelligent Agentic Systems
data.description: Series of 16 lectures explaining how language model systems are built, in order to understand and predict their behaviour.

data.name: AI Safety, Ethics and Society (AISES)
data.description: Covers a wide range of risks, including loss of control, misalignment, malicious use, etc, while leveraging concepts and frameworks from existing research fields to analyze AI safety.

data.name: Future of AI
data.description: Very short, engaging introduction to AI and its potential impacts. Good entry point to share with laypeople curious about AI.

data.name: AGI Strategy
data.description: The decisions being made today determine whether AI liberates humanity, destabilises it, or worse. This course aims to prepare participants to be part of those decisions.

data.name: Introduction to ML Safety
data.description: PhD-level survey course on technical ML safety. Covers various technical topics to reduce existential risks from AI, including robustness, monitoring, control, and systemic safety.

data.name: Introduction to AI Safety
data.description: What is safe AI, and how do we make it? This Stanford University course explores that question, focusing on the technical challenges of creating reliable, ethical, and aligned AI systems.

data.name: Alignment Research Engineer Accelerator (ARENA)
data.description: Facilitates upskilling in machine learning engineering for the purpose of contributing directly to AI alignment in technical roles.

data.name: Introduction to Cooperative AI
data.description: A primer on cooperative AI, a research field focused on improving the cooperative intelligence of advanced AI for the benefit of all.

data.name: MATS AI Safety Strategy Curriculum
data.description: As part of their program, MATS runs a series of discussion groups focused on topics relevant to prioritizing research in AI safety. This is the curriculum.

data.name: Victoria Krakovna: AI Alignment Resources
data.description: Intended to help people get up to speed on the main ideas in AI alignment i.e. ensuring advanced AI systems do what we want them to do.

data.name: CHAI: Annotated Bibliography of Recommended Materials
data.description: Reading list discussing ideas CHAI believes warrant further attention and research for the purpose of developing human-compatible AI.

data.name: Learning-Theoretic Agenda Reading List
data.description: Vanessa Kosoy's math-heavy reading list for people interested in studying the learning-theoretic agenda.

data.name: UChicago XLab AI Security Guide
data.description: Introduces AI security research through five sections covering adversarial examples, jailbreaking, model tampering, data poisoning, and information extraction.

data.name: Reading What We Can
data.description: Collection of books and articles for a 20 day reading challenge. Covers AI safety basics, ML engineering, ML upskilling, and AI safety-relevant sci-fi.

data.name: Existential Risks Introductory Course (ERIC)
data.description: Each section covers a different topic related to existential risks. The book 'The Precipice' by Toby Ord forms the majority of the core reading material.

data.name: Economics of Transformative AI
data.description: Course designed for economists who want to develop their understanding of transformative AI and its economic impacts.

data.name: Key Phenomena in AI Risk
data.description: Focused on introducing people to AI risk factors from misdirected optimization or consequentialist cognition, aiming to remain largely agnostic of solution paradigms.

data.name: AI Alignment Forum: Curated Sequences
data.description: List of sequences curated by the AI Alignment Forum team, featuring work from Richard Ngo, Paul Christiano, etc.

data.name: BlueDot Impact: Technical & Frontier AI Governance
data.description: Covers key concepts and research perspectives in AI safety, split into two main streams: Technical AI Safety and AI Governance.
